in_sanskrit.name: चामनलल
in_sanskrit.meaning: पूजा करना, सेवा करना (To serve, to worship)
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: च (Cha) - to serve, आमन (Aman) - to please, लल (Lal) - to play or enjoy. Thus, Chamanlal means one who serves, pleases and enjoys the divine.

in_hindi.name: चामनलल
in_hindi.long_meaning: च (Cha) - to serve, म (Ma) - mother, न (Na) - in, ल (La) - to serve, ल (La) - to serve. Thus, Chamanlal is a name that signifies serving and pleasing the divine as well as one's mother.

in_tamil.name: சாமனலல்
in_tamil.long_meaning: ச (Ca) - to serve, ஆட்டு (Attu) - always, கள் (Kal) - to hold or possess, அளிவத்துவம் (Aalivaththuvam) - serving attitude. Thus, Chamanlal in Tamil means one with a constant serving attitude.

in_telugu.name: చామనలల్
in_telugu.long_meaning: చ (Cha) - to serve, ఆ (Aa) - always, మ (Ma) - mother, న (Na) - in, ల (La) - to serve, ల (La) - to serve. Thus, Chamanlal in Telugu means a constant God-loving servant.

in_marathi.name: Chamanlal
in_marathi.long_meaning: Chamanlal हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Chamanlal is derived from Sanskrit words ‘Chama’ and ‘Lal’. Chama means ‘God’ and Lal means ‘servant’. Thus, Chamanlal translates to ‘God’s servant’. This name is used to denote a devout and religious person who dedicates his life to the service of God.

in_bengali.long_meaning: Chamanlal একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। The name Chamanlal is derived from Sanskrit words ‘Chama’ and ‘Lal’.
